card.name: First digit of a multi-digit number
card.fires_on: A single digit token that begins or sits inside a longer number, such as a course code, phone number, rating, or count. The next digits are still to come.

modes.label: Digit in codes and IDs
modes.description: A digit inside a course number, standard code, or phone number.
modes.example: HI <<2>>11 History of Latin America Pr

modes.label: Digit in counts and ranges
modes.description: The leading digit of a figure such as a population size or percentage range.

card.writes: It favors more characters continuing the number, such as digits, a decimal point, or a letter suffix, and disfavors word continuations.
card.plain: It fires on a digit that starts or sits within a longer number, like a code, phone number or count, where more digits follow.
